summary: American Airlines, Inc. filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (Form 424B5) for an offering of $1,051,470,000 Class A Pass Through Certificates, Series 2026-2A. The proceeds will finance 37 aircraft via equipment notes secured by the aircraft. This is a routine debt securities offering, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other event-driven transaction is involved. The filing is an ordinary capital markets transaction for fleet financing.
